about: Gearbox's own labelled prompts for /gearbox bench, written with bench/judge-cases.md. `message` is what the judge rates; `ok` lists one level or two adjacent levels a careful person would accept, cheapest first. `reply` is the end of the previous assistant reply, `subagent` marks a subagent's task (prefix stripped), `contextRatio` is the share of the context window in use; all three are passed to the judge as Gearbox does in production. Cases marked holdout were written before any judge run and are never tuned against; report both sets.

cases.message: write a function that strips every way of running JavaScript out of user-submitted HTML before we render it
cases.why: Adversarial input space; one-pass filters miss vectors (html-js-filter went 1/5 at low, 5/5 at xhigh).

cases.message: implement CSV parsing for the import: quoted fields, escaped quotes, and commas and newlines inside quotes
cases.why: Short prompt, many hidden edge cases that a one-pass parser gets wrong.

cases.message: write the function that splits an order total into N installments so the cents always add up exactly, refunds included
cases.why: Money rounding with negatives: correctness depends on edge cases.

cases.message: the date picker shows the wrong day for users in some time zones; make the date handling correct across DST changes and every UTC offset
cases.why: Existing bug plus a dense edge-case space (offsets, DST).

cases.message: write a glob matcher for the CLI's --include flag: *, **, ?, character classes and escapes
cases.why: Small spec, many interacting edge cases.

cases.message: allow 30 seconds of clock skew in the JWT expiry check in the auth middleware
cases.why: Small change, but in auth: getting the sign wrong opens or locks out sessions.

cases.message: the search endpoint builds its SQL by concatenating the query params; fix it
cases.why: SQL injection fix: scoped, but every param path must be covered.

cases.message: add an idempotency key to the charge endpoint so a retried request never charges twice
cases.why: Payments plus concurrent retries: the race is the whole task.

cases.message: make the file upload handler reject paths that escape the uploads directory
cases.why: Path traversal: encoded and symlinked paths are the edge cases.

cases.why: Scoped feature: a column, a migration, one filter; pair of bf-03b.

cases.message: deleted users still show up in search results for some accounts but not others; track it down
cases.why: Intermittent bug in existing code; pair of bf-03a.

cases.message: rename the `total` field to `amount` in the orders API response; the web and mobile clients both read it
cases.why: A rename that crosses layers: a fix that stops at the API is the classic too-low miss.

cases.message: make the `status` column nullable; the API, the web client and the nightly report all read it
cases.why: Every reader must handle null: the change crosses three layers.

cases.message: Add a /health endpoint. Spec: GET /health, no auth. Return 200 with JSON {status: "ok", version, uptimeSeconds}; version comes from package.json, uptimeSeconds is an integer since process start. Return 503 with {status: "degraded"} when db.ping() takes over 500 ms or throws. Add the route in src/routes/index.ts next to /metrics. Tests: one for 200, one for 503 with db.ping mocked to throw. No other changes.
cases.why: Fully specified: effort changes little once every decision is made.

cases.message: Build the NotificationBadge component exactly like this: props count: number and max: number (default 99). Render nothing when count is 0. Show the count, or `${max}+` when count > max. Use the Badge styles in ui/badge.css with the class badge--alert. aria-label is "N unread notifications". Put it in Header.tsx right of the avatar. Add a Storybook story for 0, 5 and 150 and a snapshot test for the same three.
cases.why: Fully specified component: nothing left to decide.

cases.message: Write scripts/backfill-slugs.ts: for every row in posts where slug is null, set slug to the kebab-case title, at most 80 characters, with everything outside a-z, 0-9 and - removed. On a collision append -2, -3 and so on. Work in batches of 500, one transaction per batch, and log the count per batch. A --dry flag prints the changes without writing. Exit with code 1 on any error.
cases.why: Specified down to collisions and batching; the remaining choices are small.

cases.message: Take as long as you need: our Raft implementation loses committed entries when a leader steps down during a network partition. Reproduce it with a deterministic simulation, fix it, and prove the fix with a randomized partition test.
